body:
## Pull request overview Phase 1 UX/accessibility polish for `@object-ui/plugin-designer`, adding ARIA semantics, basic keyboard shortcuts, improved empty states, zoom controls, richer property panels, and a collaboration connection status indicator. Also documents the audit/plan and updates the roadmap accordingly. **Changes:** - Added accessibility improvements (ARIA roles/labels, tab semantics) and improved empty-state guidance across designers. - Added basic keyboard shortcuts (Delete/Backspace to remove selection, Escape to deselect) to multiple designers and introduced PageDesigner zoom controls + label editing. - Added `ConnectionStatusIndicator` export and expanded collaboration user color palette; added UX audit doc + roadmap section. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 10 out of 10 changed files in this pull request and generated 6 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | packages/plugin-designer/src/index.tsx | Re-exports `ConnectionStatusIndicator` from `CollaborationProvider`. | | packages/plugin-designer/src/__tests__/ViewDesigner.test.tsx | Updates empty-state assertion text for ViewDesigner. | | packages/plugin-designer/src/ViewDesigner.tsx | Adds ARIA roles/labels (toolbar/tablist/tabs/buttons) and updates empty-state copy. | | packages/plugin-designer/src/ReportDesigner.tsx | Adds keyboard shortcuts, ARIA roles/labels, empty state for sections, and richer property panel details. | | packages/plugin-designer/src/ProcessDesigner.tsx | Adds keyboard shortcuts, ARIA roles/labels, and an empty state for nodes. | | packages/plugin-designer/src/PageDesigner.tsx | Adds keyboard shortcuts, zoom controls, ARIA roles/labels, improved empty state, and editable label field in properties. | | packages/plugin-designer/src/DataModelDesigner.tsx | Adds keyboard shortcuts, ARIA roles/labels, empty state, “PK” indicator, and “coming soon” messaging for Add Relationship. | | packages/plugin-designer/src/CollaborationProvider.tsx | Adds `ConnectionStatusIndicator` component and expands user color palette to 16 colors. | | ROADMAP.md | Adds “2.8 Designer UX Enhancement” phased plan section. | | DESIGNER_UX_ANALYSIS.md | New comprehensive UX audit + phased improvement plan document. |
Comments suppressed due to low confidence (2) **packages/plugin-designer/src/DataModelDesigner.tsx:134** * The “Add Relationship” button is intentionally non-functional, but it’s still focusable/clickable and not marked disabled. For accessibility and to avoid user confusion, set disabled (and/or aria-disabled) and adjust styling/tooltip accordingly until it’s implemented. ``` ``` **packages/plugin-designer/src/ViewDesigner.tsx:467** * Tabs currently set role="tablist"/role="tab" and aria-selected, but there are no associated tab panels (role="tabpanel") or aria-controls/aria-labelledby links. This can break screen reader tab semantics; add tabpanel roles/ids and wire each tab’s aria-controls and tabIndex per the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern. ```
{(['columns', 'filters', 'sort', 'options'] as const).map((tab) => ( ))}
```

Phase 1 checklist items appear marked complete but don’t fully match the implementation: (1) “role=tabpanel” isn’t implemented for the ViewDesigner tab content, (2) DataModelDesigner “Add Relationship” isn’t actually disabled, and (3) ReportDesigner still renders emoji labels (🖼/📊/📋). Either update the checklist or complete the remaining work so the document stays accurate.
```suggestion
- [x] Add `role` attributes (`toolbar`, `region`, `tablist`, `tab`) to interactive containers
- [ ] Add `role="tabpanel"` to ViewDesigner tab content containers
- [x] Add `aria-selected` to ViewDesigner tab buttons
- [x] Add keyboard shortcut handler (`Delete`, `Escape`) to all designers
- [x] Improve empty states with icons and guidance text in PageDesigner, DataModelDesigner, ProcessDesigner
- [x] Add zoom increment/decrement buttons to PageDesigner
- [x] Expand ReportDesigner property panel to show element type and basic properties
- [ ] Disable or add tooltip to DataModelDesigner "Add Relationship" button
- [x] Replace emoji key indicator (🔑) with a Lucide icon in relevant designers
- [ ] Replace remaining emoji indicators (🖼, 📊, 📋) in ReportDesigner with Lucide icons
```

The roadmap item says zoom controls include “fit”, but PageDesigner currently provides zoom in/out and a reset-to-100% button only (no fit-to-canvas calculation). Please clarify the wording here or implement an actual “fit” behavior.

The process name has aria-label="Process name", which overrides the element’s accessible name and causes screen readers to announce “Process name” instead of the actual processName text. Remove the aria-label (or use aria-labelledby on a container if needed). ```suggestion {processName} ```

selectedElementData is recomputed every render via sections.flatMap(...).find(...). With many sections/elements, this becomes unnecessary work. Consider memoizing it with useMemo keyed on sections and selectedElement.
